purpose: Represent a fail-closed risk decision between confirmation and final trade decision.
invariants: Risk Gate is downstream of confirmation.
Risk approval does not mean execution.
UNKNOWN risk evidence cannot produce approval.
No future outcome is an input.
No historical Winner/Survivor data is an input.
No leverage, position-size, stop-distance, drawdown, or RR threshold is embedded in this contract.
Every risk check must be traceable to contemporaneous evidence.
The gate fails closed when no versioned risk policy is supplied.
A policy cannot approve unless it declares a non-empty versioned required-check list.
At the gate boundary, every returned check must be well formed, uniquely named, carry a non-empty evidence reference and observation time, and have state PASS for approval.
Missing required checks, duplicate check names, malformed evidence, FAIL, or UNKNOWN in any returned check yields RISK_REJECTED.
The policy result confirmation_state must match the confirmation input state.
A risk approval requires confirmation_state CONFIRMED_LONG or CONFIRMED_SHORT.
The policy result observation time must match the gate input observation time and include non-empty reason codes.
